finding: Top-level adapter_rule retained an unrelated-only mock restriction while revised C02/C04/C06 explicitly named related prerequisite mocks. The two parts were inconsistent.
before: Never replace the new binding/policy helper with a stub that raises the expected selector. Caller controls mutate its actual logical inputs and execute that helper; only independently identified unrelated prerequisite observations/processes may be mocked.
after: Never replace the new binding/policy helper or its refusal path with a stub that raises the expected selector. Caller controls execute the real helper using the frozen logical-input mutations or labelled file-observation seam. Existing source/runtime/host/origin/libc/RTLD/guard prerequisite observations and fake processes may be stipulated only when explicitly named and labelled in the frozen control; directly related prerequisite mocks prove none of their own checks. Preserve original caller boundaries and the real new constructor/refusal path. No mocked context can establish operational STATIC_READY.
